title: Titans RB Tony Pollard has no game status, but RB Tyjae Spears is questionable

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Titans RB Tony Pollard has no game status, but RB Tyjae Spears is questionable
sources.description: The Titans will have running back Tony Pollard, who had another full practice Friday and does not have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Ravens.
